messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Restyle the person's hair according to the reference images. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle shape (front and back views). Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please go back to the video from before the first hair color change was made, then use that video as the starting point for the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: restyle the person's hair according to the reference images. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands and slowly turns, raising one arm to touch her hair and then lowering it while shifting her pose.","camera":"A static medium shot frames the character from the waist up against the horizon.","clothing":"She wears a short, form-fitting dress with a blue and white abstract pattern, three-quarter sleeves, a white collar, and an open back.","hair_color":"Medium brown.","hairstyle":"Brown hair is pulled back into a low bun with two small side buns or pigtails at the nape.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, shown mostly from the back and side.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor stone terrace or rooftop overlooking a calm sea under a clear, pale blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's hair was changed from two high buns to a low double-bun style with a center braid and side buns near the nape, matching the reference shape. The hair remains medium brown, and the dress, pose, scene, and camera remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Restyle the person's hair to match the reference images' shape, while keeping identity, hair color, clothing, and all other video aspects unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the added white collar is an unintended clothing change or a subtle artifact of the hair restyle.
unexpected_changes: A white collar/choker now appears around the character's neck, which was not visible in the source video.
